name: chime
description: Chimes and notifies when a long turn finishes or Claude waits on you

thresholdSeconds.title: Long-turn threshold (seconds)
thresholdSeconds.description: Chime when a turn takes at least this long; /chime <seconds> overrides it

notify.title: Send a notification
notify.description: Also send a desktop notification when a long turn finishes

waitingSound.title: Waiting chime
waitingSound.description: Play a softer chime when Claude waits on you (permission or input)
